ऊढि: ऊढि ऊढि, i. e. वह् + ति, f. Bringing, Rājat. 5, 173.
ऊति: ऊति ऊति, f. i. e.  I. अव् + ति,  1. As-sistance, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14; help, Lass. 98, 16 = Rigv. v. 9, 6; ऊती, ved. instr. sing, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.  2. Quickness, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 44.  II. वे + ति, Web, tissue, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 1; 4.
ऊधन्: ऊधन् ऊधन्, and, with र् for न्, ऊधर् ऊधर्, and ऊधस् ऊधस्, based on original *वद्-धन्त् (cf. उदन्, vb. धा, and पयोधस्), n. An udder.  -- Cf. οὖθαρ, uber; O.H.G. ūtar; A.S. uder.
ऊधस्वन्त्: ऊधस्वन्त् ऊधस् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having exuberant udders.
ऊन्: ऊन् ऊन्, i. 10, Par. (properly a denom. of the following), To detract.
ऊन: ऊन ऊन (probably for वन् + न from वन् = Goth. van, vans: cf. O.H.G. wên-ag, few, perhaps εὖνις, etc.), adj., f. ना।  1. Lessened, Yājñ. 2, 295.  2. Inferior, Man. 9, 123.  3. Wanting, usually as former or latter part of a comp., e. g. अल्प-, adj. Wanting, a little, Man. 8, 217. किंचिद्-, adj. A little less, Sāv. 4, 26. त्रि-भाग-, adj. Reduced by a third, Rājat. 5, 170. दशोन, i. e. दशन्-, adj. Wanting ten, Rām. 1, 46, 12. If one only is wanting, एक may be added, e. g. एकोनचत्वारिंश, i. e. एक-ऊन-, ord. The thirty-ninth, MBh. 1, adhy. 39, but usually it is dropped, e. g. ऊन -विंश, ord. The nineteenth, MBh. 3, adhy. 19. As former part, e. g. ऊन-द्वि -वार्षिक (i. e. -द्वि-वर्ष + इक), adj. A child under two years, Man. 5, 68; ऊन-षोडशवर्ष (i. e. -षष्-दशन् -वर्ष), adj. Under sixteen years, Rām. 1, 22, 2. -- Cf. probably Lat. un-, or unde-, e. g. in unde-viginti = ऊन -विंशति।
ऊय्: † ऊय् ऊय्, i. 1, Ātm. (properly वे, i. 4, Ātm.). To sew, to weave.
ऊरु: ऊरु ऊरु, perhaps akin to उरु, m. The thigh, Rām. 3, 52, 32. When the latter part of a comp. adj., the fem. ends in रु, or रू, e. g. वामोरु, i. e. वाम-, f. रू, Having beautiful thighs, MBh. 1, 1903; but रु (against the grammatical rule), MBh. 1, 2988. क-रभोपमोरु, i. e. करभ-उपम-ऊरु, f. रू, and करभोरु, i. e. करभ- f. रू, Having thighs like the proboscis of an elephant, Ragh. 6, 83; Śāk. d. 69. रम्भ-, f. रू, Having bambu-like thighs, Mālav. d. 45. वर-, f. रु, Having beautiful thighs, Rām. 3, 52, 53.  -- Comp. अन्-,  I. adj. thighless.  II. m. Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun, Skandap., Kāśīkh. 2, 13.
ऊरुज: ऊरुज ऊरु-ज, adj. Born from the thigh, MBh. 1, 6820.
ऊर्ज्: ऊर्ज् ऊर्ज्, i. 10, Par. (properly a denomin. derived from the next).  1. To nourish, to strengthen.  2. † To live. उर्जित,  1. Swollen, Rājat. 5, 214.  2. Strong, Hariv. 9920.  3. Distinguished, Ragh. 9, 38.  4. Violent, Rām. 2, 85, 2.  -- Cf. ὀργάω, ὀργάς, perhaps Lat. ur-gere.
ऊर्ज् ऊर्ज्, f. Strength, food, Chr. 295, 17 = Rigv. i. 92, 17; Bhāg. P. 4, 24, 38.
ऊर्ज: ऊर्ज ऊर्ज् + अ, m. Strength, Man. 2, 55.
ऊर्जस्कर: ऊर्जस्कर ऊर्जस्कर, i. e. ऊर्ज् + अस्-कृ + अ, adj. Causing strength, MBh. 3, 14181.
ऊर्जस्वल: ऊर्जस्वल ऊर्जस् + वल, adj., and ऊर्जस्विन् ऊर्जस् + विन्, adj., f. नी, Strong, Ragh. 2, 50.
ऊर्जावत्: ऊर्जावन्त् ऊर्ज् + आ + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abundant with food, MBh. 13, 1842.
ऊर्जावन्त्: ऊर्जावन्त् ऊर्ज् + आ + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abundant with food, MBh. 13, 1842.
ऊर्ण: ऊर्ण ऊर्ण, i. e. वृ + न, n., and f. णा, Wool, MBh. 2, 1847.  -- Comp. कर्णोर्ण, i. e. कर्ण-, adj. having wool near the ears, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 21. पत्रोर्ण, i. e. पत्र-, n. 1. Wove silk. 2. A garment of wove silk. -- Cf. Goth. vulla; A.S. wull; Lat. vellus, οὖλος.
ऊर्णमय: ऊर्णमय ऊर्ण + मय, adj., f. यी, Woollen.
ऊर्णु: ऊर्णु ऊर्णु, ii. 2, Par., Ātm. (pro-perly vb. वृ, ii. 5). To cover; Ātm. To hide one's self, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 27. -- With the prep. अप अप, To discover, Chr. 294, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 4. -- With वि वि, To discover, Chr. 295, 11 = Rigv. i. 92, 11.
ऊर्ध्व: ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्व, i. e. ऋध् + व, adj., f. वा।  1. Erect, Hiḍ. 3, 2.  2. Raised (as dust), Man. 11, 110.  3. Upper, MBh. 1, 1034.  4. The name of a kind of flying, Pañc. ii. d. 57. वम्, adv.  1. Upwards, Rām. 4, 8, 5.  2. Above, Man. 1, 92.  3. After, Rām. 3, 53, 4; after death, Man. 9, 104. -- Cf. ὀρθός; Lat. arduus.
ऊर्ध्वग: ऊर्ध्वग ऊर्ध्व-ग (vb. गम्), adj., f. गा।  1. Going upwards, MBh. 3, 850.  2. Being in the air.
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रक: ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रक ऊर्ध्व-पुण्ड्र + क, m. A perpendicular line on the forehead made with sandal, etc.; a sectarial mark, Lass. 70, 11.
ऊर्मि: ऊर्मि ऊर्मि, probably क्वृ + मि, m. and f. A wave, Bhartṛ. 2, 4.  -- Comp. क्षीर-, a wave of the sea of milk, Ragh. 4, 27.
ऊर्मिन्: ऊर्मिन् ऊर्मिन्, i. e. ऊर्मि + इन्, adj., f. णी, Wavy (ved.).  -- Comp. महा-, adj. having great waves, MBh. 3, 793.
ऊर्मिमत्: ऊर्मिमन्त् ऊर्मि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, adj. Surgy, Rām. 4, 9, 38.
ऊर्मिमन्त्: ऊर्मिमन्त् ऊर्मि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, adj. Surgy, Rām. 4, 9, 38.
ऊर्व: ऊर्व ऊर्व, m. The name of a saint from whose thighs (ऊरु) proceeded the submarine fire, Hariv. 2527 sqq.
ऊष्: † ऊष् ऊष्, ii. 1, Par. To be dis-eased.
ऊष: ऊष ऊष,  I. m. Saline earth, Man. 5, 120.  II. f. षी, Salt ground, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 21.
ऊषण: ऊषण ऊषण, i. e. ऊष् (= उष्) + अन, n. Pepper.
ऊषर: ऊषर ऊष + र, adj., f. रा, Im-pregnated with saline particles, MBh. 13, 3341.  2. Salt ground, barren land, Man. 2, 112.
ऊष्मन्: ऊष्मन् ऊष्मन् (= उष्मन्)।  1. Heat, MBh. 14, 468.  2. A name compris-ing the sibilants and ह्, Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 47.
ऊष्मप: ऊष्मप ऊष्मप, i. e. ऊष्मन्-प (vb. 1. पा).  I. adj. Drinking the steam of food only, MBh. 13, 646.  II. m. pl. The name of a class of Pitṛs or Manes, MBh. 2, 341.
ऊह्: 1. ऊह् ऊह्, i. 1, Ātm., with prepo-sitions also Par. To apprehend, MBh. 1, 5228. -- Caus. To observe, MBh. 2, 1240. -- With the prep. अपि अपि, To understand, Hit. iii. d. 33. -- With अभि अभि, To infer, Kathās. 7, 11

2. ऊह् ऊह् (derived from वह्, and appearing only after prep.), i. 1, Par. and Ātm. ऊह्यमाना, Rājat. 5, 33, is to be corrected to उह्य्°, pass. of वह्, Being carried. -- With the prep. अप अप।  1. To remove, Man. 8, 414; 11, 102 (Ātm.); अपोहित, Prab. 116, 7. -- 2. To press, to follow immediately, Ragh. 19, 5.  3. To avoid, Man. 10, 86 (Ātm.).  -- With the prep. व्यप वि-अप।  1. To remove, Man. 2, 102.  2. To expiate, Man. 11, 81.  3. To keep off, Rām. 6, 75, 57 (Ātm.). -- With उद् उद्। To raise, Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 15. -- With उप उप, To bring near, Rām. 2, 52, 6. --Pass. To begin, MBh. 2, 2051. उपोढ, Produced, Śāk. d. 169. -- With समुप सम्-उप in समुपोढ,  1. Near, Man. 6, 41.  2. Commenced, Rām. 2, 75, 29.  -- With प्रति प्रति, प्रत्यूढ।  1. De-nied, Rām. 5, 31, 14.  2. Exceeded, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 38.  3. Interrupted, Man. 5, 84. -- With वि वि, To arrange an army, Man. 7, 191. व्यूढ, Large, Rām. 6, 36, 45. -- With निर्वि निस्-वि, निर्व्यूढ  1. Brought out, MBh. 1, 6257.  2. Achieved, Kathās. 17, 159. --With प्रतिवि प्रति-वि, To arrange an army against, MBh. 3, 16370, प्रत्य्-अव्यूहत्, instead of प्रतिव्य्-औहत्; प्रतिव्यूढ, Large, Rām. 6, 35, 18.
ऊह: ऊह ऊह् + अ, m. Connected reason-ing, MBh. 13, 6725.  -- Comp. अन्-ऊह, adj. without (long) reflection, quick, Bhāg. P. 3, 5, 48; 18, 12. दुरूह, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be inferred, Man. 11, 238. v. r.
